matchbox mapping-language test resources (vendored)
===================================================
Vendored verbatim from:
  repo:    https://github.com/ahdis/matchbox
  path:    matchbox-engine/src/test/resources/mapping-language/
  commit:  86633d0
  fetched: 2026-11-04
  license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE alongside)

Contents:
  *.map, *.json       the maps the matchbox engine tests itself with, and the sources they run over
                      (the pairing is in tests/matchbox-harness.rkt, `smoke-pairs`; the Java tests
                      assert on single values, so these run without expected outputs here)
  tutorial/stepN/     the FHIR mapping-language tutorial (hl7.org/fhir/mapping-tutorial.html):
                      logical/   the step's StructureDefinitions (logical models TLeft/TRight)
                      map/       the step's maps (.map; the .json is matchbox's StructureMap form)
                      source/    TLeft instances
                      result/    <map>.<source>.json — the expected TRight, or an OperationOutcome
                                 when the run is expected to fail. Two files are not expectations of
                                 the reference (its test class never runs step4b.map, and expects
                                 step6b over source6b to throw); tests/matchbox-harness.rkt lists them
                                 as `reference-overrides` with the evidence
XML files are not vendored (JSON only, repo-wide).
